UI language version 1.
NOT ENFORCED HERE: nesting depth. JSON Schema cannot express a recursion bound, so a document valid against this schema may still exceed the stated maximum of 8. That check belongs to the validator.
Unions carry an OpenAPI `discriminator` on `component`. It is a performance affordance only: every branch has a distinct `component` const, so a validator ignoring the keyword reaches the same verdict by plain `oneOf`.
